es:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTION_.en: This update is paused. Choose Return to workspace or open diagnostics. Your backup is kept.

es:updateRecovery.return-revoked.text: Intenta salir de nuevo y luego abre Murage. Tu copia de seguridad se conserva.
es:updateRecovery.return-revoked.en: Try Quit again, then open Murage. Your backup is kept.

es:updateRecovery.installer-wait.text: Murage está instalando la actualización. Espera un momento. Tu copia de seguridad se conserva.
es:updateRecovery.installer-wait.en: Murage is installing the update. Please wait. Your backup is kept.

es:updates.installerSteps.text: Consigue la actualización en un paso: descarga Murage {version} y arrástralo a Aplicaciones. Tus chats y ajustes se conservan.
es:updates.installerSteps.en: Download Murage {version}, then drag it into Applications. Your chats and settings stay.
es:updates.installerSteps.note: Rule 5: The translation adds an unsupported claim that updating takes one step.

es:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.text: Murage no pudo terminar de cerrar su trabajo en segundo plano. Tu copia de seguridad se conserva.
es:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.en: Murage could not finish closing its background work. Your backup is kept.
es:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.note: Rule 3: The recovery message describes an app failure.

es:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.text: La actualización se dejó de lado y tu copia de seguridad se conservó.
es:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept.

es:updateRecovery.update-wait.text: Espera mientras Murage termina este paso. Tu copia de seguridad se conserva.
es:updateRecovery.update-wait.en: Please wait while Murage finishes this step. Your backup is kept.

es:backup.waiting.space.text: Las copias esperan espacio. Murage necesita unos {size} más en la unidad de tu carpeta de copias. Elimina algunos archivos o elige otra carpeta. La copia empieza sola cuando haya espacio.
es:backup.waiting.space.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

es:backup.waiting.data.text: Las copias esperan espacio. Murage necesita unos {size} más en la unidad de este ordenador donde guarda sus datos. Elimina algunos archivos. La copia empieza sola cuando haya espacio.
es:backup.waiting.data.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

es:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.text: Las copias esperan espacio en la unidad de este ordenador donde Murage guarda sus datos. Elimina algunos archivos. La copia empieza sola cuando haya espacio.
es:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

es:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.text: Las copias esperan espacio en la unidad de tu carpeta de copias. Elimina algunos archivos o elige otra carpeta. La copia empieza sola cuando haya espacio.
es:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

es:backup.waiting.drive.text: Tu unidad de copias no está conectada. Conéctala y Murage hará la copia enseguida.
es:backup.waiting.drive.en: Your backup drive isn't connected. Connect it and Murage backs up right away.

es:backup.waiting.busy.text: Las copias esperan porque un archivo que Murage necesita estaba en uso. Murage lo intentará de nuevo pronto automáticamente.
es:backup.waiting.busy.en: Backups are waiting because a file Murage needs was in use. Murage tries again by itself soon.

es:backup.waiting.interrupted.text: La última copia se interrumpió antes de terminar. Murage lo intentará de nuevo pronto automáticamente.
es:backup.waiting.interrupted.en: The last backup was interrupted before it finished. Murage tries again by itself soon.
es:backup.waiting.interrupted.note: Rule 3: The backup recovery message emphasizes an interrupted backup.

es:ux.d24.help.text: Lee las respuestas terminadas en este ordenador, en la conversación que tienes abierta. Se desactiva durante las llamadas. Requiere un servicio de voz.
es:ux.d24.help.en: Read finished replies aloud on this computer, in the conversation you have open. Off while you are on a call. Needs a hosted voice.
es:ux.d24.help.note: Rule 5: The translation omits reading aloud and the requirement for an online voice.

es:ux.d24.disclosure.text: La lectura usa un servicio de voz. Evita leer en voz alta respuestas sensibles.
es:ux.d24.disclosure.en: Speech uses a voice service. Avoid reading sensitive replies aloud.

es:ux.d24.budget.text: Respuestas en voz alta en pausa: se alcanzó el presupuesto de voz.
es:ux.d24.budget.en: Spoken replies paused: voice budget reached.

es:ux.d24.failed.text: No se pudo leer esa respuesta.
es:ux.d24.failed.note: Rule 5: “Leer” alone does not specify that the failed action was reading aloud.

es:ux.d24.hosted.text: Las respuestas en voz alta requieren un servicio de voz.
es:ux.d24.hosted.en: Spoken replies need a hosted voice.
es:ux.d24.hosted.note: Rule 5: The translation omits the requirement for an online voice.

fr:highlevel.intro.text: Laisse tes bots consulter ton CRM HighLevel. Ils peuvent le lire et ne peuvent rien y modifier.
fr:highlevel.intro.en: Let your bots look things up in your HighLevel CRM. They can read it and cannot change anything in it.

fr:highlevel.loadError.text: Les réglages HighLevel ne se sont pas chargés. Réessaie.
fr:highlevel.loadError.en: HighLevel settings did not load. Try again.

fr:highlevel.tokenNoLocation.text: Jeton enregistré. Vérifie un emplacement pour le connecter.
fr:highlevel.tokenNoLocation.en: Token saved. Check a location to connect it.

fr:highlevel.reconfirm.text: Le jeton a changé. Vérifie de nouveau l'emplacement et confirme-le.
fr:highlevel.reconfirm.en: The token changed. Check the location again and confirm it.

fr:highlevel.notReady.text: Cet emplacement n'est pas prêt. Vérifie-le de nouveau et confirme-le.
fr:highlevel.notReady.en: This location is not ready. Check it again and confirm it.

fr:highlevel.tokenHelp.text: Crée-en un dans HighLevel sous Settings, Private Integrations. Murage le garde avec tes autres clés enregistrées et ne l'affiche plus jamais ici.
fr:highlevel.tokenHelp.en: Make one in HighLevel under Settings, Private Integrations. Murage keeps it with your other saved keys and never shows it here again.

fr:highlevel.tokenRemoved.text: Jeton supprimé. Tes bots ne peuvent plus accéder à HighLevel.
fr:highlevel.tokenRemoved.en: Token removed. Your bots can no longer reach HighLevel.

fr:highlevel.tokenSaveError.text: Le jeton n'a pas été enregistré. Réessaie.
fr:highlevel.tokenSaveError.en: The token was not saved. Try again.

fr:highlevel.tokenRemoveError.text: Le jeton n'a pas été supprimé. Réessaie.
fr:highlevel.tokenRemoveError.en: The token was not removed. Try again.

fr:highlevel.locationHelp.text: Tu le trouveras dans HighLevel sous Settings, Business Profile.
fr:highlevel.locationHelp.en: Find it in HighLevel under Settings, Business Profile.

fr:highlevel.checkError.text: Impossible de vérifier cet emplacement. Assure-toi que le jeton et l'ID de l'emplacement correspondent.
fr:highlevel.checkError.en: That location could not be checked. Make sure the token and the location ID match.

fr:highlevel.found.text: {name} trouvé. Confirme pour connecter cet emplacement.
fr:highlevel.found.en: Found {name}. Confirm to connect this location.

fr:highlevel.confirmed.text: Emplacement connecté. Choisis maintenant ce que chaque bot peut faire.
fr:highlevel.confirmed.en: Location connected. Now choose what each bot may do.

fr:highlevel.confirmError.text: L'emplacement n'a pas été connecté. Vérifie-le de nouveau.
fr:highlevel.confirmError.en: The location was not connected. Check it again.

fr:highlevel.disconnected.text: Emplacement déconnecté. Tes bots ne peuvent plus y accéder.
fr:highlevel.disconnected.en: Location disconnected. Your bots can no longer reach it.

fr:highlevel.disconnectError.text: L'emplacement n'a pas été déconnecté. Réessaie.
fr:highlevel.disconnectError.en: The location was not disconnected. Try again.

fr:highlevel.botsHelp.text: Choisis quels bots peuvent lire cet emplacement.
fr:highlevel.botsHelp.en: Choose which bots may read this location.

fr:highlevel.accessError.text: L'accès n'a pas été enregistré. Réessaie.
fr:highlevel.accessError.en: Access was not saved. Try again.

fr:setup.recommendedModel.text: Recommandé pour un nouveau choix : {model}. Ton modèle enregistré reste inchangé.
fr:setup.recommendedModel.en: Recommended for new choices: {model}. Your saved model stays as it is.

fr:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.text: Murage installe encore la mise à jour. Si elle reste bloquée, quitte Murage, ouvre Moniteur d’activité, sélectionne le processus ShipIt de Murage et choisis Forcer à quitter. Rouvre ensuite Murage. Ta sauvegarde est conservée.
fr:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.en: Murage is still installing the update. If it stays stuck, quit Murage, open Activity Monitor, select the process named ShipIt for Murage, and choose Force Quit. Then open Murage again. Your backup is kept.
fr:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.note: Rule 3: The recovery instructions describe the update as stuck.

fr:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.text: Murage n’a pas pu déterminer si la mise à jour est encore en cours d’installation. Cette vérification n’a donc rien modifié. Quitte Murage et rouvre-le. Si cette page revient, ouvre le dossier de diagnostics et contacte l’assistance. Ta sauvegarde est conservée.
fr:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.en: Murage couldn't tell whether the update is still being installed, so nothing was changed by this check. Quit Murage and open it again. If this page comes back, open the diagnostics folder and contact support. Your backup is kept.
fr:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.note: Rule 3: The recovery message leads with something Murage could not do.

fr:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.text: L’application mise à jour est sur le disque, mais cette copie utilise encore l’ancienne version. Choisis Retour à l’espace de travail pour essayer d’ouvrir encore une fois l’application mise à jour, ou quitte et ouvre la copie mise à jour. Ta sauvegarde est conservée.
fr:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.en: The updated app is on disk, but this copy is still running the older version. Choose Return to workspace to try opening the updated app once more, or quit and open the updated copy. Your backup is kept.

fr:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.text: La mise à jour a été mise de côté et ta sauvegarde est conservée. Choisis Retour à l’espace de travail pour essayer de le rouvrir.
fr:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept. Choose Return to workspace to try opening your workspace again.

fr:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTION_.text: Cette mise à jour est en pause. Choisis Retour à l’espace de travail ou ouvre les diagnostics. Ta sauvegarde est conservée.
fr:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTION_.en: This update is paused. Choose Return to workspace or open diagnostics. Your backup is kept.

fr:updateRecovery.return-revoked.text: Essaie de quitter à nouveau, puis ouvre Murage. Ta sauvegarde est conservée.
fr:updateRecovery.return-revoked.en: Try Quit again, then open Murage. Your backup is kept.

fr:updateRecovery.installer-wait.text: Murage installe la mise à jour. Patiente un instant. Ta sauvegarde est conservée.
fr:updateRecovery.installer-wait.en: Murage is installing the update. Please wait. Your backup is kept.

fr:updates.installerSteps.text: Obtiens la mise à jour en une étape : télécharge Murage {version}, puis fais-le glisser dans Applications. Tes discussions et réglages sont conservés.
fr:updates.installerSteps.en: Download Murage {version}, then drag it into Applications. Your chats and settings stay.
fr:updates.installerSteps.note: Rule 5: The translation adds an unsupported claim that updating takes one step.

fr:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.text: Murage n’a pas pu terminer l’arrêt de ses tâches en arrière-plan. Ta sauvegarde est conservée.
fr:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.en: Murage could not finish closing its background work. Your backup is kept.
fr:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.note: Rule 3: The recovery message describes an app failure.

fr:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.text: La mise à jour a été mise de côté et ta sauvegarde est conservée.
fr:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept.

fr:updateRecovery.update-wait.text: Patiente pendant que Murage termine cette étape. Ta sauvegarde est conservée.
fr:updateRecovery.update-wait.en: Please wait while Murage finishes this step. Your backup is kept.

fr:backup.waiting.space.text: Les sauvegardes attendent de la place. Murage a besoin d’environ {size} de plus sur le disque du dossier de sauvegarde. Supprime des fichiers ou choisis un autre dossier. La sauvegarde démarre seule dès qu’il y a de la place.
fr:backup.waiting.space.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

fr:backup.waiting.data.text: Les sauvegardes attendent de la place. Murage a besoin d’environ {size} de plus sur le disque de cet ordinateur où il conserve ses données. Supprime des fichiers. La sauvegarde démarre seule dès qu’il y a de la place.
fr:backup.waiting.data.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

fr:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.text: Les sauvegardes attendent de la place sur le disque de cet ordinateur où Murage conserve ses données. Supprime des fichiers. La sauvegarde démarre seule dès qu’il y a de la place.
fr:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

fr:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.text: Les sauvegardes attendent de la place sur le disque du dossier de sauvegarde. Supprime des fichiers ou choisis un autre dossier. La sauvegarde démarre seule dès qu’il y a de la place.
fr:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

fr:backup.waiting.drive.text: Ton disque de sauvegarde n’est pas connecté. Connecte-le et Murage sauvegarde aussitôt.
fr:backup.waiting.drive.en: Your backup drive isn't connected. Connect it and Murage backs up right away.

fr:backup.waiting.busy.text: Les sauvegardes attendent car un fichier nécessaire à Murage était utilisé. Murage réessaiera bientôt automatiquement.
fr:backup.waiting.busy.en: Backups are waiting because a file Murage needs was in use. Murage tries again by itself soon.

fr:backup.waiting.interrupted.text: La dernière sauvegarde a été interrompue avant la fin. Murage réessaiera bientôt automatiquement.
fr:backup.waiting.interrupted.en: The last backup was interrupted before it finished. Murage tries again by itself soon.
fr:backup.waiting.interrupted.note: Rule 3: The backup recovery message emphasizes an interrupted backup.

fr:ux.d24.help.text: Lis les réponses terminées sur cet ordinateur, dans la conversation ouverte. Désactivé pendant un appel. Nécessite un service vocal.
fr:ux.d24.help.en: Read finished replies aloud on this computer, in the conversation you have open. Off while you are on a call. Needs a hosted voice.
fr:ux.d24.help.note: Rule 5: The translation omits reading aloud and the requirement for an online voice.

fr:ux.d24.disclosure.text: La lecture utilise un service vocal. Évite de lire les réponses sensibles à voix haute.
fr:ux.d24.disclosure.en: Speech uses a voice service. Avoid reading sensitive replies aloud.

fr:ux.d24.budget.text: Réponses à voix haute en pause : budget vocal atteint.
fr:ux.d24.budget.en: Spoken replies paused: voice budget reached.

fr:ux.d24.failed.text: Cette réponse n’a pas pu être lue.
fr:ux.d24.failed.note: Rule 5: “Lue” alone does not specify that the failed action was reading aloud.

fr:ux.d24.hosted.text: Les réponses à voix haute nécessitent un service vocal.
fr:ux.d24.hosted.en: Spoken replies need a hosted voice.
fr:ux.d24.hosted.note: Rule 5: The translation omits the requirement for an online voice.

hi:highlevel.intro.text: अपने बॉट्स को अपने HighLevel CRM में जानकारी देखने दें। वे इसे पढ़ सकते हैं और इसमें कुछ भी बदल नहीं सकते।
hi:highlevel.intro.en: Let your bots look things up in your HighLevel CRM. They can read it and cannot change anything in it.

hi:highlevel.loadError.text: HighLevel सेटिंग्स लोड नहीं हुईं। फिर से कोशिश करें।
hi:highlevel.loadError.en: HighLevel settings did not load. Try again.

hi:highlevel.noToken.text: अभी तक कोई टोकन सेव नहीं है।

hi:highlevel.tokenNoLocation.text: टोकन सेव हो गया। इसे जोड़ने के लिए कोई लोकेशन जाँचें।
hi:highlevel.tokenNoLocation.en: Token saved. Check a location to connect it.
hi:highlevel.tokenNoLocation.note: Rule 5: “इसे” refers to the token rather than the location being connected.

hi:highlevel.reconfirm.text: टोकन बदल गया है। लोकेशन को फिर से जाँचें और पुष्टि करें।
hi:highlevel.reconfirm.en: The token changed. Check the location again and confirm it.

hi:highlevel.notReady.text: यह लोकेशन तैयार नहीं है। इसे फिर से जाँचें और पुष्टि करें।
hi:highlevel.notReady.en: This location is not ready. Check it again and confirm it.

hi:highlevel.tokenHelp.text: इसे HighLevel में Settings, Private Integrations में बनाएँ। Murage इसे आपकी बाकी सहेजी गई कुंजियों के साथ रखता है और यहाँ फिर कभी नहीं दिखाता।
hi:highlevel.tokenHelp.en: Make one in HighLevel under Settings, Private Integrations. Murage keeps it with your other saved keys and never shows it here again.

hi:highlevel.tokenRemoved.text: टोकन हटा दिया गया। आपके बॉट्स अब HighLevel तक नहीं पहुँच सकते।
hi:highlevel.tokenRemoved.en: Token removed. Your bots can no longer reach HighLevel.

hi:highlevel.tokenSaveError.text: टोकन सेव नहीं हुआ। फिर से कोशिश करें।
hi:highlevel.tokenSaveError.en: The token was not saved. Try again.

hi:highlevel.tokenRemoveError.text: टोकन हटाया नहीं गया। फिर से कोशिश करें।
hi:highlevel.tokenRemoveError.en: The token was not removed. Try again.

hi:highlevel.locationHelp.text: यह HighLevel में Settings, Business Profile में मिलेगी।
hi:highlevel.locationHelp.en: Find it in HighLevel under Settings, Business Profile.

hi:highlevel.checkError.text: उस लोकेशन की जाँच नहीं हो सकी। पक्का करें कि टोकन और लोकेशन ID मेल खाते हों।
hi:highlevel.checkError.en: That location could not be checked. Make sure the token and the location ID match.

hi:highlevel.found.text: {name} मिला। इस लोकेशन को जोड़ने के लिए पुष्टि करें।
hi:highlevel.found.en: Found {name}. Confirm to connect this location.

hi:highlevel.confirmed.text: लोकेशन जुड़ गई। अब चुनें कि हर बॉट क्या कर सकता है।
hi:highlevel.confirmed.en: Location connected. Now choose what each bot may do.

hi:highlevel.confirmError.text: लोकेशन नहीं जुड़ी। इसे फिर से जाँचें।
hi:highlevel.confirmError.en: The location was not connected. Check it again.

hi:highlevel.disconnected.text: लोकेशन डिस्कनेक्ट हो गई। आपके बॉट्स अब इस तक नहीं पहुँच सकते।
hi:highlevel.disconnected.en: Location disconnected. Your bots can no longer reach it.

hi:highlevel.disconnectError.text: लोकेशन डिस्कनेक्ट नहीं हुई। फिर से कोशिश करें।
hi:highlevel.disconnectError.en: The location was not disconnected. Try again.

hi:highlevel.botsHelp.text: चुनें कि कौन से बॉट्स इस लोकेशन को पढ़ सकते हैं।
hi:highlevel.botsHelp.en: Choose which bots may read this location.

hi:highlevel.accessError.text: एक्सेस सेव नहीं हुआ। फिर से कोशिश करें।
hi:highlevel.accessError.en: Access was not saved. Try again.

hi:setup.recommendedModel.text: नए चुनाव के लिए सुझाव: {model}। आपका सहेजा गया मॉडल नहीं बदलेगा।
hi:setup.recommendedModel.en: Recommended for new choices: {model}. Your saved model stays as it is.

hi:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.text: Murage अभी अपडेट इंस्टॉल कर रहा है। अगर यह अटका रहे, तो Murage बंद करें, Activity Monitor खोलें, Murage का ShipIt नाम का प्रोसेस चुनें और Force Quit चुनें। फिर Murage दोबारा खोलें। आपका बैकअप रखा गया है।
hi:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.en: Murage is still installing the update. If it stays stuck, quit Murage, open Activity Monitor, select the process named ShipIt for Murage, and choose Force Quit. Then open Murage again. Your backup is kept.
hi:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.note: Rule 3: The recovery instructions describe the update as stuck.

hi:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.text: Murage यह तय नहीं कर सका कि अपडेट अभी भी इंस्टॉल हो रहा है या नहीं, इसलिए इस जाँच ने कुछ नहीं बदला। Murage बंद करके दोबारा खोलें। अगर यह पेज फिर आए, तो डायग्नोस्टिक्स फ़ोल्डर खोलें और सहायता से संपर्क करें। आपका बैकअप रखा गया है।
hi:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.en: Murage couldn't tell whether the update is still being installed, so nothing was changed by this check. Quit Murage and open it again. If this page comes back, open the diagnostics folder and contact support. Your backup is kept.
hi:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.note: Rule 3: The recovery message leads with something Murage could not do.

hi:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.text: अपडेट किया गया ऐप डिस्क पर है, लेकिन यह कॉपी अभी पुराना संस्करण चला रही है। अपडेट किया गया ऐप एक बार और खोलने के लिए कार्यक्षेत्र पर वापस जाएँ चुनें, या बंद करके अपडेट की गई कॉपी खोलें। आपका बैकअप रखा गया है।
hi:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.en: The updated app is on disk, but this copy is still running the older version. Choose Return to workspace to try opening the updated app once more, or quit and open the updated copy. Your backup is kept.

hi:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.text: अपडेट अलग रख दिया गया है और आपका बैकअप रखा गया है। कार्यक्षेत्र दोबारा खोलने के लिए कार्यक्षेत्र पर वापस जाएँ चुनें।
hi:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept. Choose Return to workspace to try opening your workspace again.

hi:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTION_.text: यह अपडेट रुका हुआ है। कार्यक्षेत्र पर वापस जाएँ चुनें या डायग्नोस्टिक्स खोलें। आपका बैकअप रखा गया है।
hi:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTION_.en: This update is paused. Choose Return to workspace or open diagnostics. Your backup is kept.

hi:updateRecovery.return-revoked.text: फिर से बंद करने की कोशिश करें, फिर Murage खोलें। आपका बैकअप रखा गया है।
hi:updateRecovery.return-revoked.en: Try Quit again, then open Murage. Your backup is kept.

hi:updateRecovery.installer-wait.text: Murage अपडेट इंस्टॉल कर रहा है। कृपया इंतज़ार करें। आपका बैकअप रखा गया है।
hi:updateRecovery.installer-wait.en: Murage is installing the update. Please wait. Your backup is kept.

hi:updates.installerSteps.text: एक ही चरण में अपडेट पाएं: Murage {version} डाउनलोड करें, फिर उसे Applications में खींचें। आपकी चैट और सेटिंग्स बनी रहती हैं।
hi:updates.installerSteps.en: Download Murage {version}, then drag it into Applications. Your chats and settings stay.
hi:updates.installerSteps.note: Rule 5: The translation adds an unsupported claim that updating takes one step.

hi:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.text: Murage अपना बैकग्राउंड काम बंद नहीं कर सका। आपका बैकअप रखा गया है।
hi:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.en: Murage could not finish closing its background work. Your backup is kept.
hi:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.note: Rule 3: The recovery message describes an app failure.

hi:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.text: अपडेट अलग रख दिया गया है और आपका बैकअप रखा गया है।
hi:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept.

hi:updateRecovery.update-wait.text: कृपया Murage के इस चरण को पूरा करने तक इंतज़ार करें। आपका बैकअप रखा गया है।
hi:updateRecovery.update-wait.en: Please wait while Murage finishes this step. Your backup is kept.

hi:backup.waiting.space.text: बैकअप जगह का इंतज़ार कर रहे हैं। बैकअप फ़ोल्डर वाली ड्राइव पर Murage को लगभग {size} और जगह चाहिए। कुछ फ़ाइलें हटाएँ या दूसरा फ़ोल्डर चुनें। जगह मिलने पर बैकअप अपने आप शुरू होगा।
hi:backup.waiting.space.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

hi:backup.waiting.data.text: बैकअप जगह का इंतज़ार कर रहे हैं। इस कंप्यूटर की उस ड्राइव पर, जहाँ Murage अपना डेटा रखता है, लगभग {size} और जगह चाहिए। कुछ फ़ाइलें हटाएँ। जगह मिलने पर बैकअप अपने आप शुरू होगा।
hi:backup.waiting.data.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

hi:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.text: बैकअप इस कंप्यूटर की उस ड्राइव पर जगह का इंतज़ार कर रहे हैं, जहाँ Murage अपना डेटा रखता है। कुछ फ़ाइलें हटाएँ। जगह मिलने पर बैकअप अपने आप शुरू होगा।
hi:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

hi:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.text: बैकअप फ़ोल्डर वाली ड्राइव पर जगह का इंतज़ार है। कुछ फ़ाइलें हटाएँ या दूसरा फ़ोल्डर चुनें। जगह मिलने पर बैकअप अपने आप शुरू होगा।
hi:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

hi:backup.waiting.drive.text: आपकी बैकअप ड्राइव जुड़ी नहीं है। इसे जोड़ें और Murage तुरंत बैकअप लेगा।
hi:backup.waiting.drive.en: Your backup drive isn't connected. Connect it and Murage backs up right away.

hi:backup.waiting.busy.text: Murage को चाहिए एक फ़ाइल उपयोग में थी, इसलिए बैकअप इंतज़ार कर रहे हैं। Murage जल्द ही अपने आप फिर कोशिश करेगा।
hi:backup.waiting.busy.en: Backups are waiting because a file Murage needs was in use. Murage tries again by itself soon.
hi:backup.waiting.busy.note: Rule 7: “Murage को चाहिए एक फ़ाइल” has unnatural, incorrect word order.

hi:backup.waiting.interrupted.text: पिछला बैकअप पूरा होने से पहले रुक गया। Murage जल्द ही अपने आप फिर कोशिश करेगा।
hi:backup.waiting.interrupted.en: The last backup was interrupted before it finished. Murage tries again by itself soon.
hi:backup.waiting.interrupted.note: Rule 3: The backup recovery message emphasizes an interrupted backup.

hi:ux.d24.help.text: इस कंप्यूटर पर खुली बातचीत के पूरे हो चुके जवाब पढ़कर सुनाएँ। कॉल के दौरान बंद रहता है। वॉइस सेवा चाहिए।
hi:ux.d24.help.en: Read finished replies aloud on this computer, in the conversation you have open. Off while you are on a call. Needs a hosted voice.
hi:ux.d24.help.note: Rule 5: The translation omits the requirement for an online voice.

hi:ux.d24.disclosure.text: बोलने के लिए वॉइस सेवा का उपयोग होता है। संवेदनशील जवाब ज़ोर से पढ़ने से बचें।
hi:ux.d24.disclosure.en: Speech uses a voice service. Avoid reading sensitive replies aloud.

hi:ux.d24.budget.text: बोलकर दिए गए जवाब रुके हैं: वॉइस बजट पूरा हो गया।
hi:ux.d24.budget.en: Spoken replies paused: voice budget reached.

hi:ux.d24.failed.text: वह जवाब पढ़कर नहीं सुनाया जा सका।

hi:ux.d24.hosted.text: जवाब पढ़कर सुनाने के लिए वॉइस सेवा चाहिए।
hi:ux.d24.hosted.en: Spoken replies need a hosted voice.
hi:ux.d24.hosted.note: Rule 5: The translation omits the requirement for an online voice.

ja:highlevel.intro.text: ボットが HighLevel の CRM で情報を調べられるようにします。ボットは読み取りだけができ、内容を変更することはできません。
ja:highlevel.intro.en: Let your bots look things up in your HighLevel CRM. They can read it and cannot change anything in it.

ja:highlevel.loading.text: HighLevel を読み込んでいます…

ja:highlevel.loadError.text: HighLevel の設定を読み込めませんでした。もう一度お試しください。
ja:highlevel.loadError.en: HighLevel settings did not load. Try again.

ja:highlevel.noToken.text: トークンはまだ保存されていません。

ja:highlevel.tokenNoLocation.text: トークンを保存しました。接続するロケーションを確認してください。
ja:highlevel.tokenNoLocation.en: Token saved. Check a location to connect it.

ja:highlevel.reconfirm.text: トークンが変更されました。ロケーションをもう一度確認して承認してください。
ja:highlevel.reconfirm.en: The token changed. Check the location again and confirm it.

ja:highlevel.notReady.text: このロケーションは準備ができていません。もう一度確認して承認してください。
ja:highlevel.notReady.en: This location is not ready. Check it again and confirm it.

ja:highlevel.tokenLabel.text: プライベート連携トークン

ja:highlevel.pasteToken.text: トークンを貼り付けてください

ja:highlevel.pasteReplacement.text: 新しいトークンを貼り付けてください

ja:highlevel.tokenHelp.text: HighLevel の Settings、Private Integrations で作成してください。Murage はトークンをほかの保存済みキーと一緒に保管し、ここに再び表示することはありません。
ja:highlevel.tokenHelp.en: Make one in HighLevel under Settings, Private Integrations. Murage keeps it with your other saved keys and never shows it here again.

ja:highlevel.tokenSavedNotice.text: トークンを保存しました。

ja:highlevel.tokenRemoved.text: トークンを削除しました。ボットは HighLevel にアクセスできなくなりました。
ja:highlevel.tokenRemoved.en: Token removed. Your bots can no longer reach HighLevel.

ja:highlevel.tokenSaveError.text: トークンを保存できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。
ja:highlevel.tokenSaveError.en: The token was not saved. Try again.

ja:highlevel.tokenRemoveError.text: トークンを削除できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。
ja:highlevel.tokenRemoveError.en: The token was not removed. Try again.

ja:highlevel.locationHelp.text: HighLevel の Settings、Business Profile で確認できます。
ja:highlevel.locationHelp.en: Find it in HighLevel under Settings, Business Profile.

ja:highlevel.checkError.text: そのロケーションを確認できませんでした。トークンとロケーション ID が一致しているか確かめてください。
ja:highlevel.checkError.en: That location could not be checked. Make sure the token and the location ID match.

ja:highlevel.found.text: {name} が見つかりました。承認するとこのロケーションに接続します。
ja:highlevel.found.en: Found {name}. Confirm to connect this location.

ja:highlevel.confirmed.text: ロケーションを接続しました。次に、各ボットができることを選んでください。
ja:highlevel.confirmed.en: Location connected. Now choose what each bot may do.

ja:highlevel.confirmError.text: ロケーションを接続できませんでした。もう一度確認してください。
ja:highlevel.confirmError.en: The location was not connected. Check it again.

ja:highlevel.disconnected.text: ロケーションの接続を解除しました。ボットはこのロケーションにアクセスできなくなりました。
ja:highlevel.disconnected.en: Location disconnected. Your bots can no longer reach it.

ja:highlevel.disconnectError.text: ロケーションの接続を解除できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。
ja:highlevel.disconnectError.en: The location was not disconnected. Try again.

ja:highlevel.botsHelp.text: このロケーションを読み取れるボットを選んでください。
ja:highlevel.botsHelp.en: Choose which bots may read this location.

ja:highlevel.canReadFor.text: {name} は HighLevel を読み取れます

ja:highlevel.accessSaved.text: アクセス設定を保存しました。

ja:highlevel.accessError.text: アクセス設定を保存できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。
ja:highlevel.accessError.en: Access was not saved. Try again.

ja:setup.recommendedModel.text: 新しく選ぶ場合のおすすめ：{model}。保存済みのモデルは変わりません。
ja:setup.recommendedModel.en: Recommended for new choices: {model}. Your saved model stays as it is.

ja:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.text: Murage はまだアップデートをインストールしています。進まない場合は Murage を終了し、アクティビティモニタで Murage の ShipIt プロセスを選び、強制終了してください。その後 Murage をもう一度開いてください。バックアップは保持されます。
ja:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.en: Murage is still installing the update. If it stays stuck, quit Murage, open Activity Monitor, select the process named ShipIt for Murage, and choose Force Quit. Then open Murage again. Your backup is kept.
ja:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.note: Rule 3: The recovery instructions describe installation as unable to progress.

ja:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.text: アップデートがまだインストール中か確認できなかったため、この確認では何も変更していません。Murage を終了してもう一度開いてください。このページが再び表示される場合は、診断フォルダを開いてサポートに連絡してください。バックアップは保持されます。
ja:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.en: Murage couldn't tell whether the update is still being installed, so nothing was changed by this check. Quit Murage and open it again. If this page comes back, open the diagnostics folder and contact support. Your backup is kept.
ja:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.note: Rule 3: The recovery message leads with an unsuccessful check.

ja:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.text: 更新済みのアプリはディスクにありますが、このコピーはまだ以前のバージョンを実行しています。「ワークスペースに戻る」を選んで更新済みアプリをもう一度開くか、終了して更新済みのコピーを開いてください。バックアップは保持されます。
ja:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.en: The updated app is on disk, but this copy is still running the older version. Choose Return to workspace to try opening the updated app once more, or quit and open the updated copy. Your backup is kept.

ja:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.text: アップデートは見送られ、バックアップは保持されています。「ワークスペースに戻る」を選んでもう一度開いてください。
ja:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept. Choose Return to workspace to try opening your workspace again.

ja:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTION_.text: このアップデートは一時停止しています。「ワークスペースに戻る」を選ぶか、診断を開いてください。バックアップは保持されます。
ja:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTION_.en: This update is paused. Choose Return to workspace or open diagnostics. Your backup is kept.

ja:updateRecovery.return-revoked.text: もう一度終了を試してから Murage を開いてください。バックアップは保持されます。
ja:updateRecovery.return-revoked.en: Try Quit again, then open Murage. Your backup is kept.

ja:updateRecovery.installer-wait.text: Murage はアップデートをインストールしています。お待ちください。バックアップは保持されます。
ja:updateRecovery.installer-wait.en: Murage is installing the update. Please wait. Your backup is kept.

ja:updates.installerTitle.text: Murage {version} の準備ができました

ja:updates.installerSteps.text: ワンステップでアップデートできます。Murage {version} をダウンロードして、アプリケーションフォルダにドラッグしてください。チャットと設定はそのまま残ります。
ja:updates.installerSteps.en: Download Murage {version}, then drag it into Applications. Your chats and settings stay.
ja:updates.installerSteps.note: Rule 5: The translation adds an unsupported claim that updating takes one step.

ja:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.text: Murage はバックグラウンド処理の終了を完了できませんでした。バックアップは保持されます。
ja:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.en: Murage could not finish closing its background work. Your backup is kept.
ja:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.note: Rule 3: The recovery message describes an app failure.

ja:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.text: アップデートは見送られ、バックアップは保持されています。
ja:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept.

ja:updateRecovery.update-wait.text: Murage がこの手順を完了するまでお待ちください。バックアップは保持されています。
ja:updateRecovery.update-wait.en: Please wait while Murage finishes this step. Your backup is kept.

ja:backup.waiting.space.text: バックアップは空き容量を待っています。バックアップフォルダーのドライブに、あと約{size}必要です。ファイルをいくつか削除するか、別のフォルダーを選んでください。容量が確保されると自動で開始します。
ja:backup.waiting.space.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

ja:backup.waiting.data.text: バックアップは空き容量を待っています。Murageがデータを保存するこのコンピューターのドライブに、あと約{size}必要です。ファイルをいくつか削除してください。容量が確保されると自動で開始します。
ja:backup.waiting.data.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

ja:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.text: バックアップは、Murageがデータを保存するこのコンピューターのドライブの空き容量を待っています。ファイルをいくつか削除してください。容量が確保されると自動で開始します。
ja:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

ja:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.text: バックアップはバックアップフォルダーのドライブの空き容量を待っています。ファイルをいくつか削除するか、別のフォルダーを選んでください。容量が確保されると自動で開始します。
ja:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

ja:backup.waiting.drive.text: バックアップドライブが接続されていません。接続するとMurageがすぐにバックアップします。
ja:backup.waiting.drive.en: Your backup drive isn't connected. Connect it and Murage backs up right away.

ja:backup.waiting.busy.text: 必要なファイルが使用中だったため、バックアップは待機しています。Murageはまもなく自動で再試行します。
ja:backup.waiting.busy.en: Backups are waiting because a file Murage needs was in use. Murage tries again by itself soon.

ja:backup.waiting.interrupted.text: 前回のバックアップは完了前に中断されました。Murageはまもなく自動で再試行します。
ja:backup.waiting.interrupted.en: The last backup was interrupted before it finished. Murage tries again by itself soon.
ja:backup.waiting.interrupted.note: Rule 3: The backup recovery message emphasizes an interrupted backup.

ja:ux.d24.help.text: このコンピューターで開いている会話の完成した回答を読み上げます。通話中は無効になります。音声サービスが必要です。
ja:ux.d24.help.en: Read finished replies aloud on this computer, in the conversation you have open. Off while you are on a call. Needs a hosted voice.
ja:ux.d24.help.note: Rule 5: The translation omits the requirement for an online voice.

ja:ux.d24.disclosure.text: 読み上げには音声サービスを使用します。機密情報を含む回答の読み上げは避けてください。

ja:ux.d24.budget.text: 読み上げを一時停止しました。音声の予算上限に達しました。

ja:ux.d24.hosted.note: Rule 5: The translation omits the requirement for an online voice.

pt-br:highlevel.tokenSaveError.text: O token não foi salvo. Tente de novo.
pt-br:highlevel.tokenSaveError.en: The token was not saved. Try again.

pt-br:highlevel.tokenRemoveError.text: O token não foi removido. Tente de novo.
pt-br:highlevel.tokenRemoveError.en: The token was not removed. Try again.

pt-br:highlevel.locationHelp.text: Você encontra no HighLevel em Settings, Business Profile.
pt-br:highlevel.locationHelp.en: Find it in HighLevel under Settings, Business Profile.

pt-br:highlevel.checkError.text: Não foi possível verificar esse local. Confira se o token e o ID do local combinam.
pt-br:highlevel.checkError.en: That location could not be checked. Make sure the token and the location ID match.

pt-br:highlevel.found.text: {name} encontrado. Confirme para conectar este local.
pt-br:highlevel.found.en: Found {name}. Confirm to connect this location.

pt-br:highlevel.confirmed.text: Local conectado. Agora escolha o que cada bot pode fazer.
pt-br:highlevel.confirmed.en: Location connected. Now choose what each bot may do.

pt-br:highlevel.confirmError.text: O local não foi conectado. Verifique de novo.
pt-br:highlevel.confirmError.en: The location was not connected. Check it again.

pt-br:highlevel.disconnected.text: Local desconectado. Seus bots não conseguem mais acessá-lo.
pt-br:highlevel.disconnected.en: Location disconnected. Your bots can no longer reach it.

pt-br:highlevel.disconnectError.text: O local não foi desconectado. Tente de novo.
pt-br:highlevel.disconnectError.en: The location was not disconnected. Try again.

pt-br:highlevel.botsHelp.text: Escolha quais bots podem ler este local.
pt-br:highlevel.botsHelp.en: Choose which bots may read this location.

pt-br:highlevel.accessError.text: O acesso não foi salvo. Tente de novo.
pt-br:highlevel.accessError.en: Access was not saved. Try again.

pt-br:setup.recommendedModel.text: Recomendado para novas escolhas: {model}. Seu modelo salvo não muda.
pt-br:setup.recommendedModel.en: Recommended for new choices: {model}. Your saved model stays as it is.

pt-br:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAG.text: O Murage ainda está instalando a atualização. Se ela ficar travada, encerre o Murage, abra o Monitor de Atividade, selecione o processo ShipIt do Murage e escolha Forçar Encerrar. Depois abra o Murage novamente. Seu backup será mantido.
pt-br:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAG.en: Murage is still installing the update. If it stays stuck, quit Murage, open Activity Monitor, select the process named ShipIt for Murage, and choose Force Quit. Then open Murage again. Your backup is kept.
pt-br:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAG.note: Rule 3: The recovery instructions describe the update as stuck.

pt-br:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVI.text: O Murage não conseguiu determinar se a atualização ainda está sendo instalada, então esta verificação não alterou nada. Encerre o Murage e abra novamente. Se esta página voltar, abra a pasta de diagnósticos e entre em contato com o suporte. Seu backup será mantido.
pt-br:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVI.en: Murage couldn't tell whether the update is still being installed, so nothing was changed by this check. Quit Murage and open it again. If this page comes back, open the diagnostics folder and contact support. Your backup is kept.
pt-br:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVI.note: Rule 3: The recovery message leads with something Murage could not do.

pt-br:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.text: O aplicativo atualizado está no disco, mas esta cópia ainda está executando a versão anterior. Escolha Voltar ao espaço de trabalho para tentar abrir o aplicativo atualizado mais uma vez, ou encerre e abra a cópia atualizada. Seu backup será mantido.
pt-br:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.en: The updated app is on disk, but this copy is still running the older version. Choose Return to workspace to try opening the updated app once more, or quit and open the updated copy. Your backup is kept.

pt-br:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.text: A atualização foi deixada de lado e seu backup foi mantido. Escolha Voltar ao espaço de trabalho para tentar abri-lo novamente.
pt-br:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept. Choose Return to workspace to try opening your workspace again.

pt-br:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTI.text: Esta atualização está pausada. Escolha Voltar ao espaço de trabalho ou abra os diagnósticos. Seu backup será mantido.
pt-br:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTI.en: This update is paused. Choose Return to workspace or open diagnostics. Your backup is kept.

pt-br:updateRecovery.return-revoked.text: Tente encerrar novamente e depois abra o Murage. Seu backup será mantido.
pt-br:updateRecovery.return-revoked.en: Try Quit again, then open Murage. Your backup is kept.

pt-br:updateRecovery.installer-wait.text: O Murage está instalando a atualização. Aguarde. Seu backup será mantido.
pt-br:updateRecovery.installer-wait.en: Murage is installing the update. Please wait. Your backup is kept.

pt-br:updates.installerSteps.text: Atualize em um passo: baixe o Murage {version} e arraste-o para Aplicativos. Suas conversas e configurações continuam.
pt-br:updates.installerSteps.en: Download Murage {version}, then drag it into Applications. Your chats and settings stay.
pt-br:updates.installerSteps.note: Rule 5: The translation adds an unsupported claim that updating takes one step.

pt-br:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.text: O Murage não conseguiu terminar de encerrar o trabalho em segundo plano. Seu backup será mantido.
pt-br:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.en: Murage could not finish closing its background work. Your backup is kept.
pt-br:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.note: Rule 3: The recovery message describes an app failure.

pt-br:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.text: A atualização foi deixada de lado e seu backup foi mantido.
pt-br:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept.

pt-br:updateRecovery.update-wait.text: Aguarde enquanto o Murage conclui esta etapa. Seu backup está preservado.
pt-br:updateRecovery.update-wait.en: Please wait while Murage finishes this step. Your backup is kept.

pt-br:backup.waiting.space.text: Os backups estão aguardando espaço. O Murage precisa de cerca de {size} a mais na unidade da pasta de backup. Remova alguns arquivos ou escolha outra pasta. O backup começa sozinho quando houver espaço.
pt-br:backup.waiting.space.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

pt-br:backup.waiting.data.text: Os backups estão aguardando espaço. O Murage precisa de cerca de {size} a mais na unidade deste computador onde guarda seus dados. Remova alguns arquivos. O backup começa sozinho quando houver espaço.
pt-br:backup.waiting.data.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

pt-br:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.text: Os backups estão aguardando espaço na unidade deste computador onde o Murage guarda seus dados. Remova alguns arquivos. O backup começa sozinho quando houver espaço.
pt-br:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

pt-br:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.text: Os backups estão aguardando espaço na unidade da pasta de backup. Remova alguns arquivos ou escolha outra pasta. O backup começa sozinho quando houver espaço.
pt-br:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

pt-br:backup.waiting.drive.text: Sua unidade de backup não está conectada. Conecte-a e o Murage fará o backup imediatamente.
pt-br:backup.waiting.drive.en: Your backup drive isn't connected. Connect it and Murage backs up right away.

pt-br:backup.waiting.busy.text: Os backups estão aguardando porque um arquivo necessário estava em uso. O Murage tentará novamente em breve, automaticamente.
pt-br:backup.waiting.busy.en: Backups are waiting because a file Murage needs was in use. Murage tries again by itself soon.

pt-br:backup.waiting.interrupted.text: O último backup foi interrompido antes de terminar. O Murage tentará novamente em breve, automaticamente.
pt-br:backup.waiting.interrupted.en: The last backup was interrupted before it finished. Murage tries again by itself soon.
pt-br:backup.waiting.interrupted.note: Rule 3: The backup recovery message emphasizes an interrupted backup.

pt-br:ux.d24.help.text: Leia as respostas concluídas neste computador, na conversa aberta. Desativado durante chamadas. Requer um serviço de voz.
pt-br:ux.d24.help.en: Read finished replies aloud on this computer, in the conversation you have open. Off while you are on a call. Needs a hosted voice.
pt-br:ux.d24.help.note: Rule 5: The translation omits reading aloud and the requirement for an online voice.

pt-br:ux.d24.disclosure.text: A leitura usa um serviço de voz. Evite ler respostas sensíveis em voz alta.
pt-br:ux.d24.disclosure.en: Speech uses a voice service. Avoid reading sensitive replies aloud.

pt-br:ux.d24.budget.text: Respostas em voz alta pausadas: orçamento de voz atingido.
pt-br:ux.d24.budget.en: Spoken replies paused: voice budget reached.

pt-br:ux.d24.failed.text: Não foi possível ler essa resposta.
pt-br:ux.d24.failed.note: Rule 5: “Ler” alone does not specify that the failed action was reading aloud.

pt-br:ux.d24.hosted.text: Respostas em voz alta precisam de um serviço de voz.
pt-br:ux.d24.hosted.en: Spoken replies need a hosted voice.
pt-br:ux.d24.hosted.note: Rule 5: The translation omits the requirement for an online voice.

zh:highlevel.intro.text: 让你的机器人在 HighLevel CRM 中查找信息。它们只能读取，不能更改其中的任何内容。
zh:highlevel.intro.en: Let your bots look things up in your HighLevel CRM. They can read it and cannot change anything in it.

zh:highlevel.loadError.text: HighLevel 设置未能加载，请重试。
zh:highlevel.loadError.en: HighLevel settings did not load. Try again.

zh:highlevel.tokenNoLocation.text: 令牌已保存。请检查一个位置以完成连接。
zh:highlevel.tokenNoLocation.en: Token saved. Check a location to connect it.

zh:highlevel.reconfirm.text: 令牌已更改。请重新检查该位置并确认。
zh:highlevel.reconfirm.en: The token changed. Check the location again and confirm it.

zh:highlevel.notReady.text: 此位置尚未就绪。请重新检查并确认。
zh:highlevel.notReady.en: This location is not ready. Check it again and confirm it.

zh:highlevel.tokenHelp.text: 在 HighLevel 的 Settings、Private Integrations 中创建。Murage 会把它和你保存的其他密钥放在一起，之后不会再在这里显示。
zh:highlevel.tokenHelp.en: Make one in HighLevel under Settings, Private Integrations. Murage keeps it with your other saved keys and never shows it here again.

zh:highlevel.tokenRemoved.text: 令牌已移除。你的机器人无法再访问 HighLevel。
zh:highlevel.tokenRemoved.en: Token removed. Your bots can no longer reach HighLevel.

zh:highlevel.tokenSaveError.en: The token was not saved. Try again.

zh:highlevel.tokenRemoveError.en: The token was not removed. Try again.

zh:highlevel.locationHelp.text: 可在 HighLevel 的 Settings、Business Profile 中找到。
zh:highlevel.locationHelp.en: Find it in HighLevel under Settings, Business Profile.

zh:highlevel.checkError.text: 无法检查该位置。请确认令牌和位置 ID 相匹配。
zh:highlevel.checkError.en: That location could not be checked. Make sure the token and the location ID match.

zh:highlevel.found.text: 已找到 {name}。确认后即可连接此位置。
zh:highlevel.found.en: Found {name}. Confirm to connect this location.

zh:highlevel.confirmed.text: 位置已连接。现在选择每个机器人可以做什么。
zh:highlevel.confirmed.en: Location connected. Now choose what each bot may do.

zh:highlevel.confirmError.text: 位置未能连接，请重新检查。
zh:highlevel.confirmError.en: The location was not connected. Check it again.

zh:highlevel.disconnected.text: 位置已断开。你的机器人无法再访问它。
zh:highlevel.disconnected.en: Location disconnected. Your bots can no longer reach it.

zh:highlevel.disconnectError.en: The location was not disconnected. Try again.

zh:highlevel.botsHelp.text: 选择哪些机器人可以读取此位置。
zh:highlevel.botsHelp.en: Choose which bots may read this location.

zh:highlevel.accessError.text: 访问权限未能保存，请重试。
zh:highlevel.accessError.en: Access was not saved. Try again.

zh:setup.recommendedModel.text: 新选择推荐：{model}。已保存的模型保持不变。
zh:setup.recommendedModel.en: Recommended for new choices: {model}. Your saved model stays as it is.
zh:setup.recommendedModel.note: Rule 5: “新选择推荐” is an unnatural phrase in Chinese.

zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.text: Murage 仍在安装更新。如果一直没有进展，请退出 Murage，打开“活动监视器”，选择 Murage 的 ShipIt 进程，然后选择“强制退出”。之后重新打开 Murage。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.en: Murage is still installing the update. If it stays stuck, quit Murage, open Activity Monitor, select the process named ShipIt for Murage, and choose Force Quit. Then open Murage again. Your backup is kept.
zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.note: Rule 3: The recovery instructions describe installation as unable to progress.

zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.text: Murage 无法判断更新是否仍在安装，因此这次检查没有更改任何内容。请退出 Murage 并重新打开。如果再次出现此页面，请打开诊断文件夹并联系支持。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.en: Murage couldn't tell whether the update is still being installed, so nothing was changed by this check. Quit Murage and open it again. If this page comes back, open the diagnostics folder and contact support. Your backup is kept.
zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.note: Rule 3: The recovery message leads with something Murage could not do.

zh:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.text: 更新后的应用已在磁盘上，但此副本仍在运行旧版本。选择“返回工作区”以再次尝试打开更新后的应用，或退出并打开更新后的副本。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.landed-not-running.en: The updated app is on disk, but this copy is still running the older version. Choose Return to workspace to try opening the updated app once more, or quit and open the updated copy. Your backup is kept.

zh:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.text: 更新已搁置，备份已保留。选择“返回工作区”以尝试重新打开工作区。
zh:updateRecovery.return-unconfirmed.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept. Choose Return to workspace to try opening your workspace again.

zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTION_.text: 此更新已暂停。请选择“返回工作区”或打开诊断。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_ACTION_.en: This update is paused. Choose Return to workspace or open diagnostics. Your backup is kept.

zh:updateRecovery.return-revoked.text: 请再次尝试退出，然后打开 Murage。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.return-revoked.en: Try Quit again, then open Murage. Your backup is kept.

zh:updateRecovery.installer-wait.text: Murage 正在安装更新。请稍候。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.installer-wait.en: Murage is installing the update. Please wait. Your backup is kept.

zh:updates.installerSteps.text: 一步完成更新：下载 Murage {version}，然后把它拖到“应用程序”文件夹。你的聊天和设置都会保留。
zh:updates.installerSteps.en: Download Murage {version}, then drag it into Applications. Your chats and settings stay.
zh:updates.installerSteps.note: Rule 5: The translation adds an unsupported claim that updating takes one step.

zh:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.text: Murage 无法完成后台任务的关闭。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.en: Murage could not finish closing its background work. Your backup is kept.
zh:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.note: Rule 3: The recovery message describes an app failure.

zh:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.text: 更新已搁置，备份已保留。
zh:updateRecovery.settled-stopped.en: The update was set aside and your backup was kept.

zh:updateRecovery.update-wait.text: 请等待 Murage 完成此步骤。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.update-wait.en: Please wait while Murage finishes this step. Your backup is kept.

zh:backup.waiting.space.text: 备份正在等待空间。备份文件夹所在的驱动器还需要约 {size} 空间。请删除一些文件或选择其他文件夹。有空间后，备份会自动开始。
zh:backup.waiting.space.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

zh:backup.waiting.data.text: 备份正在等待空间。Murage 存储数据的本机驱动器还需要约 {size} 空间。请删除一些文件。有空间后，备份会自动开始。
zh:backup.waiting.data.en: Backups are waiting for space. Murage needs about {size} more on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

zh:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.text: 备份正在等待 Murage 存储数据的本机驱动器腾出空间。请删除一些文件。有空间后，备份会自动开始。
zh:backup.waiting.dataUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on this computer's drive, where Murage keeps its data. Remove some files. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

zh:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.text: 备份正在等待备份文件夹所在的驱动器腾出空间。请删除一些文件或选择其他文件夹。有空间后，备份会自动开始。
zh:backup.waiting.spaceUnknown.en: Backups are waiting for space on the drive with your backup folder. Remove some files or choose a different folder. The backup starts by itself when there's room.

zh:backup.waiting.drive.text: 备份驱动器未连接。连接后，Murage 会立即备份。
zh:backup.waiting.drive.en: Your backup drive isn't connected. Connect it and Murage backs up right away.

zh:backup.waiting.busy.text: Murage 所需的文件之前正在使用，备份正在等待。Murage 很快会自动重试。
zh:backup.waiting.busy.en: Backups are waiting because a file Murage needs was in use. Murage tries again by itself soon.

zh:backup.waiting.interrupted.text: 上次备份在完成前中断。Murage 很快会自动重试。
zh:backup.waiting.interrupted.en: The last backup was interrupted before it finished. Murage tries again by itself soon.
zh:backup.waiting.interrupted.note: Rule 3: The backup recovery message emphasizes an interrupted backup.

zh:ux.d24.help.text: 在此电脑上朗读当前打开的对话中已完成的回复。通话期间关闭。需要语音服务。
zh:ux.d24.help.en: Read finished replies aloud on this computer, in the conversation you have open. Off while you are on a call. Needs a hosted voice.
zh:ux.d24.help.note: Rule 5: The translation omits the requirement for an online voice.

zh:ux.d24.disclosure.text: 朗读会使用语音服务。请避免朗读敏感回复。
zh:ux.d24.disclosure.en: Speech uses a voice service. Avoid reading sensitive replies aloud.

zh:ux.d24.budget.text: 回复朗读已暂停：已达到语音预算上限。
zh:ux.d24.budget.en: Spoken replies paused: voice budget reached.

zh:ux.d24.hosted.text: 朗读回复需要语音服务。
zh:ux.d24.hosted.en: Spoken replies need a hosted voice.
zh:ux.d24.hosted.note: Rule 5: The translation omits the requirement for an online voice.
